operatorEvidence.summary: cocharge publishes 0.59 EUR/kWh gross as a selling price in its FAQ, but also explicitly allows hosts to define an individual community tariff, different day/night prices and their own blocking fee; roaming users can see partner pricing. Therefore no operator-wide exact tariff may be inferred from the 0.59 EUR/kWh figure.

policy: Treat DE*COC as station/EVSE-specific. Rank only EVSEs carrying exact current evidence. Do not propagate the 0.59 EUR/kWh FAQ selling price or the Haan 0.87 EUR/kWh observation to other cocharge points. Keep unmatched cocharge stations visible and unranked until an exact QR, AFIR/Mobilithek, CPO backend or equivalent station-level source is available. Time/idle components observed on third-party pages are deliberately not encoded here unless their trigger semantics are unambiguous.
